settings.title: Cloud architecture diagrams (TerraVision, experimental)
settings.description: For tasks about cloud infrastructure, the architect also draws the target cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) with TerraVision, and after a merge that changes Terraform the app redraws it from the code itself, without a model. Ordinary tasks are not affected. Optional and off by default: turn it on and install uv and Graphviz (and Terraform or OpenTofu to draw from code).

design.title: Design the target cloud architecture
design.description:
Design the target cloud architecture of this project. Change no application code.

1. Read the project: the code, compose files, .env.example, README and CI workflows.
2. Find the cloud it already points at (for example Azure: Entra ID sign-in, Azure Storage through Azurite locally, Application Insights) and keep to it.
3. Describe the target cloud architecture: where the API and the web app run, the database, storage, sign-in, monitoring and networking.
4. Draw it with TerraVision as a cloud architecture graph and render it (SVG and draw.io) into the spec's architecture diagrams, next to the other diagrams.
5. Write an ADR for each main choice.

The result stays in this task's Architecture tab.
